description.en: The name of the quota usage alert.

description.zh:
本次读取的最大记录条数。

取值范围：1~200。默认值：30。
description.en:
The maximum number of records to return.

Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 30.

description.zh:
用来标记开始读取数据的位置。

> 不设置该参数，表示从头开始。
description.en:
The token that specifies the start point of the query.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the query starts from the beginning.

description.zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

> 关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见[ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~)中的`ProductCode`。
description.en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

> To obtain the abbreviation of an Alibaba Cloud service name, see the `ProductCode` parameter in [ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~).

description.zh:
配额ID。

> - 关于如何获取云产品的配额ID，请参见[ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~)中的`QuotaActionCode`。
> - 如果已设置本参数，则`ProductCode`必填。
description.en:
The quota ID.

> - To obtain the quota ID of an Alibaba Cloud service, see the `QuotaActionCode` parameter in [ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~).
>
> - If you specify this parameter, you must also specify `ProductCode`.

description.zh:
配额维度的Key。

> - N的取值范围取决于云产品支持的维度个数。
> - 当`ProductCode`为`ecs`、`ecs-spec`、`actiontrail`、`ess`等时，配额维度的Key和Value必须同时设置。
description.en:
The key of the quota dimension.

> - The number of key-value pairs that you can specify for the quota dimensions varies based on the Alibaba Cloud service.
>
> - If you set `ProductCode` to `ecs`, `ecs-spec`, `actiontrail`, or `ess`, you must specify both the key and value for the quota dimension.

description.zh:
配额维度的Key。

> - N的取值范围取决于云产品支持的维度个数。
> - 当`ProductCode`为`ecs`、`ecs-spec`、`actiontrail`、`ess`等时，配额维度的Key和Value必须同时设置。
description.en:
The value of the quota dimension.

> - The number of key-value pairs that you can specify for the quota dimensions varies based on the Alibaba Cloud service.
>
> - If you set `ProductCode` to `ecs`, `ecs-spec`, `actiontrail`, or `ess`, you must specify both the key and value for the quota dimension.

title.zh: 查询配额用量告警列表

descriptions.zh: 配额告警功能已升级，本API即将废弃，本API仅可查询旧版配额用量告警列表，若您想查询新版配额用量告警列表，请您使用云监控API [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~2513291~~)进行操作。使用API对新版配额告警进行操作的更多信息，请参见[使用API管理新版配额告警](~~2863234~~)。
descriptions.en: The quota alert feature has been upgraded. This API operation is scheduled for deprecation and queries only earlier-version quota usage alerts. To query new-version quota usage alerts, call the CloudMonitor API operation [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~2513291~~). For more information about how to manage new-version quota alerts using API operations, see [Use API operations to manage new-version quota alerts](~~2863234~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun quotas list-quota-alarms --next-token 1 --max-results 20 --product-code ecs --alarm-name q_hvnoqv_alarm --quota-action-code q_hvnoqv --quota-dimensions Value=cn-hangzhou Key=regionId --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun quotas ListQuotaAlarms --region cn-hangzhou --QuotaActionCode q_hvnoqv --QuotaDimensions.1.Value 'cn-hangzhou' --NextToken 1 --AlarmName q_hvnoqv_alarm --ProductCode ecs --MaxResults 20 --QuotaDimensions.1.Key regionId
